description: List the courses you are enrolled in with IDs, names, codes, term and your current grade. Read-only. Only active courses unless include_concluded is set. Start here to get course_id values for other tools.

include_concluded.description: If true, also include courses from finished terms.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_courses
title: List Courses
